commands.code:
gv[43] = -1
selected = $actors.select { |pkmn| pkmn.db_symbol == :shaymin }
selected.each_with_index do |pkmn| 
  result = pkmn.form_calibrate(:gracidea)
  gv[43] = $actors.index(pkmn) if result && gv[43] == -1
end
return if gv[43] == -1
text = ::PFM::Text
text.set_variable(text::PKNAME[0], $actors[gv[43]].given_name)
